messages.subject: For Hanna Opsahl-Ben Ammar | External affairs, decarbonisation and international execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Nass,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Hanna Opsahl-Ben Ammar, Executive Vice President, People, External Affairs & Chief of Staff.

Yara's global industrial footprint and decarbonisation agenda place government relations, external affairs, energy-transition partnerships and disciplined stakeholder execution close to long-term value creation. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating functions, and translate external expectations into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of external affairs, government relations, sustainability and operator-side energy-transition experience might support Yara's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Yara International.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
